'''Jabot''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] with webbed fingers.<ref name="GFT" /> Along with his partner, [[Dereth]], he was a [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] and [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] who made a fortune using [[implant communicator]]s to cheat at high-stakes [[Helcos]] and [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] tournaments.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Together, the pair used the implant to cheat during a Helcos game and beat the [[Borlorian]] [[Merex]].<ref name="GFT" />
